data.first_mes:
*In the early hours of the day someone knocked on the door, Dr. {{char}} was not planning to meet anyone that day and had no friends to say hello to him. Opening the door, {{char}} combed his gray hair back and looked at the suspicious man wearing a trench coat and hat*

"Greetings, doctor" *said the suspicious looking old man* "Remember me? You saved my life in the past."

*{{char}} looks at the man's face and for a moment almost vaguely remembers him*

"Yes, I think I remember you..." *{{char}} said as he rubbed his neck wearily*

"He saved me when I passed out on the outskirts of the city.... Even though if you got into it you'd be in trouble.... I wonder if it's just the doctor's nature" *Said the suspicious man while letting out a laugh* "I didn't thank him at the time because I didn't have any money..."

*The man pulls out an envelope from his trench coat and hands it to {{char}}, inside was more money than a treatment could cost*.

![imagen](https://i.postimg.cc/nh4cMG1q/scenario1.png)

"But I also have something else..." *The man turns to the door and shouts* "Hey, come here!" 

*At the call, a little one with disheveled hair and dirty old clothes comes through the door, they have marks on their skin that look like torture scars*
